📊 Randal #KoloMuani is the #Juventus player with the most direct goal contributions in the 2026/27 season, considering all competitions.He has a total of eight: four goals and four asistsSERIE AHis three contributions in the championship all came away from home:▪️ Goal against #Cagliari ▫️ Assist against #Sassuolo ▪️ Assist against #Fiorentina [@junews24com via @PuebloJ]

👀 "#Juventus has chosen a management strategy without intervening on the manager.There is an ironclad will to move forward: in internal evaluations, the conclusion was reached that #Spalletti is not the sole responsible.THE PLAN▪️ Do not change the manager▫️ Recover the injured players▪️ Make moves in the January mercato to sort things outAt the end of the season, a balance sheet of the Mister's entire journey will be made."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🚑 Pierre #Kalulu, #Juventus right-back, aims to return on November 29, for the match against #Como at the Sinigaglia. Test at the J Medical showed a low-grade injury to his left biceps femoris: about three weeks out.Due to the injury he suffered in Florence, he had to withdraw from the France National Team.THE MATCHESHe will definitely miss the match against #Venezia, upon the resumption of the championship.He will also not be considered for the match against #Omonia, in the Europa League.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

🚑 Kenan #Yildiz, from #Juventus, has already returned to training at la Continassa.In the coming days, he should gradually increase the intensify of his workload.The objective is for him to be available to #Spalletti during the course of December, depending on the evaluations of the medical staff and the player's response to training loads.At the Bulgarelli Award, in Bolonia, the Turk confirmed:"Yes, I'm returning in December.I feel good and I'm very homesick."[@tuttosport via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]
✅‼️Odds are down for a January loan departure for Jeff #Ekhator. #Juventus intends to keep him.[Mirko Di Natale]

👀 Luciano #Spalletti, #Juventus coach, re-watched the match against #Fiorentina during the night and analyzed it immediately at la Continassa.The entire coaching staff woke up very early: from #Domenichini to #Martusciello, passing by #Russo and #Sinatti.This took place on a day when the sports center was left without the eleven players who went to join their national teams.Early in the morning, the coach and his collaborators worked, and in the afternoon the team did too, with a post-match recovery session.THE END AT THE FRANCHIAt the end of the match, #Spalletti was deeply affected by the insults from the Fiesole stands directed at his mother Ilva, who passed away in July.[@PaoloPirisi on
